orgDesign.companyProfile: Product-led B2B SaaS company serving engineering organizations with AI-assisted technical design and collaboration workflows.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Cross-functional product teams own distinct workflow areas while a small platform layer supports enterprise governance, integrations, and metering.
designPrinciples: Treat technical design work as a recurring product workflow, not a one-off authoring event.
Keep enterprise trust features strong enough for procurement without turning daily collaboration into admin work.
Use code-connected automation to reduce documentation drift rather than creating more manual process.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Group teams by recurring customer workflow and shared product surface.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
